data.one_liner: Widget that lets you dismiss a page in any direction with custom gestures
data.what_it_does: DismissiblePage wraps a child and allows the user to swipe the page away in any direction. It handles nested scrollables, custom thresholds, haptics, and provides a handle to control dismissal programmatically.
use_when: You want a custom page dismissal gesture instead of the default back button
You need to dismiss a page from code or confirm dismissal before popping
You need to coordinate dismissal with inner scrollables like ListView or PageView
avoid_when: You only need the standard Navigator.pop behavior
Your app targets Flutter versions older than 3.27
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single widget
Supports all major platforms and nested scrollables
Highly customizable thresholds, directions, and visual effects
weaknesses: Requires Flutter >=3.27, not usable on older SDKs
No built‑in support for deep link navigation or complex route stacks
Limited to page dismissal, not general navigation
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, wrap target page with DismissiblePage or use builder for scrollables
